newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil shuts 110,000 bpd topper after fire.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil shuts 110,000 bpd topper after fire.

text.p: Refiner Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday it had halted the operation of its 110,000 barrel per day (bpd) crude distillation unit in Sakai, central Japan, after a fire broke out there this morning.
The fire was extinguished at 0730 a.m. (2230 GMT Wednesday), 15 minutes after it broke out, a Cosmo Oil spokesman said.
"We are looking into the cause of the fire and it is unclear when we will be able to resume operations," he said.
He said any shortages arising from the closure of the Sakai refinery would be covered by measures such as increasing throughput at the nearby Sakaide refinery.
The Sakaide refinery has a capacity of 140,000 bpd.
No injuries from the fire have been reported, he added.
